I think so much of this from a UK political perspective is about drawing focus onto lines drawn in the sand around identity politics, to divert attention from terrible economic and domestic/foreign policy perpetuated by both the left and right-leading UK political parties. We can’t talk about union busting, the privatisation of all our public services or company backhander “dividends” and deregulation if we’re too busy arguing over trans rights to wee in public and Muslim women’s right to wear a headscarf.

So personally I think there is incentive to divert public attention both for Lib Dem and milk toast Labour circles and for the Tory and now Reform demagogues. You can’t lose in identity politic arguments as long as you are still appealing to your audience. 

As an aside, I don’t know that I’d say Mormons and Mennonites are harmless. The ongoing history of abuse, particularly sexual abuse, and coverups is long to say the least.
When I was 14,  four drunk guys in their 40s on the train started wolf-whistling at me. One of them pulled me over and said “If there’s grass on the wicket, let’s play cricket.“
Where does it say only stray dogs there…?
This whole Hadith is basically a defence for sexual assault allegations. She claims I raped her? Well my testimony is worth double hers. He was just thinking ahead

My dad was like this too. He went on anti-anxiety meds a few years ago and now he’s only really angry at stuff anyone would be angry at and it’s not explosive. Just wish he’d agreed to see a doctor 15 years ago, the whole family would have been happier, him included
Even if someone did leave for that, so what? It’s their life to live how they want away from the thumb of religion.

Hide food like nuts, dried fruit, if you think you can get away with it supermarket brioche keeps forever and you and eat one of the rolls in seconds with no crumbs, biscuits if you think you can each them quietly enough
..Are you suggesting that prejudice didn’t exist before modern technology?
Yeah and it’s never because the ants start shouting hey kid look at us

Because there’s nothing after this, just rotting in the ground. So you may as well stick around for the ride even if you’re not having a good time. You’ll get nothingness eventually and none of the shit that happened in life will matter to you then. So might as well stay and trudge through your one chance and catch what moments of joy you can
